In 2024, Gregory Kissling put a name to the idea: “Watch dial.” It captures the point at which a recognizable watch was still a collection of choices—before familiarity made those choices seem inevitable. Even on paper, it carries restless intelligence—something like a lamp still burning in the workshop.
